title: STOP Sending Your Resume Like This | How Does Ats Work
caption:
Ever wonder why you apply for jobs you're 100% qualified for and hear nothing back? 👀

Here is the truth about how does ats work:
1. Automated systems parse text hierarchically.
2. Tables and graphics get stripped out.
3. Keywords must match the role context.

Save this Reel before your next application and share it with someone currently job hunting! 📌
cta: Save this Reel for later and follow @talentxcel for daily career tips!
opening_hook: Stop scrolling if you're actively applying for jobs. ATS isn't actively trying to reject you — it's trying to group you. Here is the single formatting mistake confusing it.
